notes: THINKING IS ALWAYS-ON for the entire Gemini 3 series (3.1 Pro, 3.5 Flash, 3-flash-preview, 3.1 Flash-Lite, 3-pro-image). Control is thinkingConfig.thinking_level with values minimal|low|medium|high. It CANNOT be fully disabled — 'minimal' is the closest to off. Per-tier defaults: Pro=high, 3.5 Flash=medium, Flash-Lite=low.

THINKING IS TOGGLEABLE for Gemini 2.5 Flash and 2.5 Flash-Lite via thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget: 2.5 Flash range 0-24576 (0 disables, -1 dynamic); 2.5 Flash-Lite range 512-24576 (0 disables, -1 dynamic). Gemini 2.5 PRO CANNOT disable thinking (budget 128-32768, no 0). Common headless bug: passing thinkingBudget:0 to 2.5 Pro errors.

PARAMETER NAMING GOTCHA for CLI/headless dispatch: Gemini 3 uses thinking_level (string enum); Gemini 2.5 uses thinkingBudget/thinking_budget (integer). Passing thinkingBudget to a Gemini 3 model or thinking_level to a 2.5 model is wrong and a likely gauntlet-failure source.

ENDPOINT: Preview models (anything *-preview) are served on the v1beta endpoint; GA models are on v1 (and also v1beta). For the gemini CLI / headless, target v1beta when using preview ids to avoid 'model not found'.

FREE-TIER / QUOTA CAVEAT (headless gauntlet failures): exact free-tier RPM/TPM/RPD numbers are NOT published in the static docs (the rate-limits page is JS-gated and defers to AI Studio). Community + docs indicate free-tier daily quotas were cut hard (Flash free tier reported ~20 RPD) and preview models carry tighter limits. For reliable headless/gauntlet runs use a billed tier (Tier 1+); do NOT depend on free-tier quota for preview ids.

WARPOS DISPATCH RECOMMENDATION: For stable non-preview headless dispatch, gemini-2.5-flash remains the safest GA default (matches existing MEMORY guidance that gemini-3.1-* were once ghosts). gemini-3.5-flash is now GA and is the better fast model if confirmed live in your account; gemini-3.1-pro-preview is the reasoning flagship but is a PREVIEW id (v1beta, tighter quota) — verify it is servable before relying on it.
All chat/reasoning Gemini models share context_window 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output and knowledge_cutoff January 2025.

Pricing free_tier: the pricing page lists free-of-charge tokens for these models on the free tier, but free usage is bounded by the (low, unpublished) rate-limit quotas — 'free' does not mean 'unlimited'.
